title: Exmouth Wild Prawn Festival postponed in aftermath of Cyclone Narelle damage
desc: Organisers confirmed the decision following significant impacts to homes, businesses and infrastructure across the coastal town, with the focus now on supporting the local community.

title: Drunk driver in fatal Klang crash remanded for four days
desc: KLANG: Police have remanded a motorist in his 20s who allegedly caused a fatal accident on Jalan Raya Barat here while intoxicated.

title: Team Baahubali cheers for Aditya Dhar as Dhurandhar 2 breaks Rajamouli film's 9-year-old North America box office record
desc: Baahubali 2 makers took to social media to celebrate the milestone set by Aditya Dhar's Dhurandhar 2, which feature Ranveer Singh.

title: Finland reports drone crashes, alleges territorial violation
desc: Two unidentified drones crashed in southern Finland. According to the country's prime minister, the drones may have been Ukrainian drones that strayed into Finnish airspace.

title: India rolls out funding programme to power AI cancer diagnostics
desc: India has launched the Cancer AI & Technology Challenge (CATCH) Grant Programme to develop artificial intelligence-based cancer screening and diagnostics.

title: Monetary Policy Committee will need to make ‘some finely balanced judgments’ - RBNZ chief economist
desc: Reserve Bank chief economist Paul Conway says supply shocks are not easy for central banks and the Monetary Policy Committee will need to make ‘some finely balanced judgments’

title: Malaysian rock singer Ella to stage Singapore concert in May
desc: Malaysian singer Ella will stage her Majlis Tertinggi Rockqueen concert in Singapore on May 9 at The Star Theatre.

title: PDP Convention: Saraki says gathering confirms party’s readiness to field candidates in 2027
desc: “We now have a party that people can no longer blackmail or make fun of them that they will not be on the ballot. Now we know PDP will be on the ballot paper in 2027. This is a great achievement,” he said.

title: Cobre Limited (ASX:CBE) Completion of Capital Raise and Further Sinomine Investment
desc: Cobre Limited (ASX:CBE) announced, following the approval of shareholders at the Extraordinary General Meeting held on 25 March 2026, the completion of the capital raising to fund Cobre's interest in the acquisition of the Sierra Atacama Copper Mine in the Antofagasta region in Northern Chile.

title: Orlando Magic Suffer Historic 52-Point Loss to Raptors, Worst in Franchise History
desc: The Orlando Magic had an unfortunate NBA history against the Toronto Raptors.
